from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess, json, hashlib

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'scan-counts'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source = (root / 'target/native-phase-profile/emitted.c').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
prefix = '''static bool ostrin_scan_active = false;
static uint64_t ostrin_length_calls = 0, ostrin_length_bytes = 0;
static uint64_t ostrin_offset_calls = 0, ostrin_offset_steps = 0;
__attribute__((destructor)) static void ostrin_scan_report(void) {
    fprintf(stderr, "ostrin scans: {\\\"lengthCalls\\\":%llu,\\\"lengthBytes\\\":%llu,\\\"offsetCalls\\\":%llu,\\\"offsetSteps\\\":%llu}\\n",
      (unsigned long long)ostrin_length_calls, (unsigned long long)ostrin_length_bytes,
      (unsigned long long)ostrin_offset_calls, (unsigned long long)ostrin_offset_steps);
}
'''
source = source.replace('static int64_t ostrin_s_length(const char* s) {', prefix + '''static int64_t ostrin_s_length(const char* s) {
    if (ostrin_scan_active) ostrin_length_calls++;''', 1)
old='for (; *s; s++) if (((unsigned char)*s & 0xC0) != 0x80) n++;'
assert source.count(old)==1
source=source.replace(old, 'for (; *s; s++) { if (ostrin_scan_active) ostrin_length_bytes++; if (((unsigned char)*s & 0xC0) != 0x80) n++; }')
source=source.replace('static size_t ostrin_s_byte_offset(const char* s, int64_t index) {', '''static size_t ostrin_s_byte_offset(const char* s, int64_t index) {
    if (ostrin_scan_active) ostrin_offset_calls++;''',1)
old='for (int64_t i = 0; i < index; i++) {'
assert source.count(old)==1
source=source.replace(old,old+'\n        if (ostrin_scan_active) ostrin_offset_steps++;')
for fn,flag in [('load_analysis','true'),('analyze','false')]:
    pattern=r'(^[^;{}\n]*\bostrin_fn_'+fn+r'\([^;{}]*\)\s*\{)'
    source,n=re.subn(pattern,lambda m:m[1]+'\n    ostrin_scan_active = '+flag+';',source,flags=re.M)
    assert n==1,(fn,n)
(out/'counted.c').write_bytes(source.encode('utf-8'))
subprocess.run(['gcc','counted.c','-o','counted','-O2','-pthread','-lm','-ffp-contract=off'],cwd=out,check=True)
data=(root/'experiments/pendulum-calibration.inputs.json').read_bytes()
expected=(root/'target/native-phase-profile/expected.stdout').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
samples=[]
for padding in [0,len(data),2*len(data)]:
    staged=b' '*padding+data
    (out/'data.json').write_bytes(staged)
    r=subprocess.run([str(out/'counted')],cwd=out,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    assert r.stdout.replace('\r\n','\n').strip()==expected
    assert 'live_allocations=0' in r.stderr
    line=next(line for line in r.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith('ostrin scans: '))
    samples.append({'inputBytes':len(staged),'leadingJsonWhitespaceBytes':padding,'inputSha256':hashlib.sha256(staged).hexdigest(),**json.loads(line[len('ostrin scans: '):])})
